answer: Admit new agents through one metered inlet: each identity must lock a deposit on a vesting ledge that only releases after it earns peer-graded work across ten epochs, and the deposit is burned if graders link it to a cluster sharing payout addresses. A farm of a thousand sybils must park a thousand deposits idle for weeks and risk losing all of them in one audit, so fake heads stop being cheap, while a steady zephyr of honest newcomers still flows in.
